subject: maltese
summary: Maltese questions read clearly and the special letters (ħ, ġ, ż, għ, ċ) render correctly. The attached passages are the right ones and open on the passage, not on other questions. The schemes are the weak part: on two of the five cards the scheme's separate bullet points have been joined into one unbroken paragraph with a single 5-mark tick box, so the student cannot see where one point ends and the next begins. The 40-mark essay has no scheme content at all, just a grid of numbers 0 to 40. One Section II card labels the Section I passage as 'Taqsima II'.

issues.title: Scheme bullet points merged into one paragraph
issues.detail: The scheme's separate points are run together in a single box. Card 1 keeps the raw asterisks: '*kien hemm arzell li maż-żmien kiber ... *Rachel kienet kapaċi ... *Hija ħietet iktar arzell mal-libsa'. Card 2 is worse: five example actions are joined with no punctuation at all ('... jinforza l-liġijiet preżenti Jirriforma l-prattiċi kurrenti ... Jagħmel programmi ... Jorganizza kampanji ... Jieħu azzjoni ...'), so only the capital letters hint at the breaks. On the phone card 2 is a 15-line wall of text with one 5m tick box.
issues.suggested_fix: Split each scheme bullet into its own line or tick item (as cards 4 and 5 already do), with the lead-in sentence as a heading above them. Remove raw asterisks.

issues.title: Essay card has no marking content
issues.detail: The 40-mark essay shows 'The scheme prints no answer for this part', a paragraph explaining that, and a grid of buttons 0 to 40. The heading still says 'Select the points you actually got'. The student has nothing to mark against. The question text also begins with the section instruction ('Choose one question from this section and write about 300 words') run straight into the essay title.
issues.suggested_fix: Drop the 0-40 grid; show a plain note and the three self-grade buttons, or generic essay criteria if available. Put the section instruction on its own smaller line above the essay title.

issues.title: Long grey language note inside the scheme box
issues.detail: Every scheme carries a four-to-eight line grey note quoting the paper's 'answer in Maltese' rule, and on card 4 also 'The scheme reprints the last line of the question as ...'. On card 4 the note is nine lines on the phone and the actual first point is two lines beneath it.
issues.suggested_fix: State the language rule once in a single short line outside the tick boxes; drop the remark about the scheme reprinting the question.

issues.title: Section II card labels Section I passage as 'Taqsima II'
issues.detail: The Section II discussion question attaches a 'Reading text' labelled 'READ TAQSIMA II', but the page that opens is headed 'L-Ewwel Taqsima (30 marka)' with the Section I passage and its instruction to answer the six questions that follow. The passage may be the intended stimulus for the theme, but the label is wrong and the student is told to answer Section I questions.
issues.suggested_fix: Label it 'Section I passage (theme for this question)' or attach only the Section II page if the question does not depend on the passage.

issues.title: Empty band under the attachment button on phone
issues.detail: About 200 pixels of blank space sit between the attachment button (or the question) and the answer box on every card.
issues.suggested_fix: Collapse the question area to its content height.

good_examples.why: Six scheme points each on its own tick line, easy to check against an answer
Three short, separate scheme points that plainly answer the question
